title: Whole-Body Scan, Wiring Matrix, and Shadow Detector Runtime

invariants.ast_parsing: Must parse module imports recursively using AST.
invariants.wiring_matrix: Must map specifications physical evidence targets to python modules.
invariants.shadow_runtime: Must classify unimported, unmapped modules as orphaned shadow files.

gates.unvalidated_specs: Spec file has 0 physical evidence targets in workspace.
gates.orphaned_tests: Test file exists but its tested module does not exist.
gates.stale_reports: Report file in .aiwg/reports/ is older than 24 hours.
